definitions.churn: revision events in the year / laws in force that year
definitions.instability: share of laws in force revised at least once in the year
definitions.median_gap_months: median months since the same law's previous event, over the year's revisions
definitions.scopes: federal, cantonal, and all — 'all' is computed over the pooled events, not averaged from the other two
definitions.lines_changed: lines added + removed per revision, summed (federal in practice — see coverage)
definitions.articles_revised: articles of the revised laws, summed over the year's revisions (federal and cantonal alike)
definitions.laws_in_force: laws whose publication year is on or before this year and whose repeal, if recorded, is after it

coverage.lines_changed_note: delta comes from git numstat on the backdated consolidation commits, and diffing needs two recorded versions of a file. Federal law has a version history; the cantonal corpus was imported at one version per law, so only 368 of 19,575 cantonal files have anything to diff and cantonal cells report no lines rather than zero lines. Each law's earliest recorded version carries no delta either — that commit is the text entering the corpus, not the law changing.
coverage.articles_revised_note: counted from the markdown body, which every law in the corpus has, so this magnitude has no scope gap. It credits each event with the law's current article count: exact for recent years, anachronistic for old ones.
